Web resolveModelPickerJumpTargets now pairs enabled rows in listed order with their jump command; Web and Lynx labels and actions all read it, and the Lynx-only catalog-order helper is deleted.

nativeProbe.route: sessionless thread, model picker open at 1280x820

slices.change: Sidebar V2 thread context-menu inventory is built by Web buildSidebarV2ThreadContextMenuItems for both renderers. Lynx loses its extra Archive item, follows Web order (Mark unread before copy actions), disables Snooze when the thread cannot snooze, always offers Copy path and toasts "Path unavailable" like Web. Delete honours the confirmThreadDelete setting and uses the shared projectThreadActionConfirmation copy on both renderers. The unreachable Lynx in-row action list (its trigger was already removed) and its CSS are deleted; the Lynx leaf keeps only the rename field and delete confirmation.
pendingUserSession: Secondary-click the thread row to open the native menu and pick Delete with confirmation on and off (DevTool touches carry no mouse button).
carried: verifyShellInteractions still taps the removed [data-sidebar-thread-action-trigger]; that step was already stale before this slice.

slices.change: Sidebar V2 row prominence and status pills come from Web resolveSidebarV2RowPresentation and isSidebarV2ThreadWoke for both renderers. Lynx gains the Woke and Done pills, recedes in-flight rows like Web instead of only ready ones, keeps unread/woke rows prominent, and applies the same rules to settled rows. Lynx rasterizes lucide circle-check and alarm-clock for the new pill icons.
slices.coverage: Pill ordering, recede rules, and the woke-visit rule are unit-tested in Sidebar.logic.test.ts; the m1 fixture has no unread or woken thread to show a pill natively.

slices.change: Lynx splits active and settled threads with the user sidebarAutoSettleAfterDays setting instead of the hard-coded default, shows Web "No threads found" for an empty search, and reads row and settled time labels from shared sidebarV2ThreadTimeLabel / sidebarV2SettledTimeLabel.

getDisplayModelName and getTriggerDisplayModelName move from Web providerIconUtils (which imports DOM icons) to client-runtime model-picker; Web re-exports them. Lynx rows use the short name only when unlocked and strip the sub-provider qualifier like Web, and the Composer trigger uses the trigger name instead of the full model name.
